记住决定，而不是描述：代理内存的率失真框架Remember the Decision, Not the Description: A Rate-Distortion Framework for Agent Memory

Mingxi Zou1  Zhihan Guo2  Langzhang Liang1  Zhuo Wang1  Qifan Wang3
Qingsong Wen4  Irwin King2  Lizhen Qu5,*  Zenglin Xu6,1,*
1Fudan University
2The Chinese University of Hong Kong
3Meta AI
4AI Research Institute, Squirrel Ai Learning
5Monash University
6Shanghai Academy of AI for Science
*Corresponding authors
摘要Abstract

长视野语言代理必须在有限的运行时内存下运行，但现有的内存机制通常围绕描述性标准（相关性、显着性或摘要质量）组织经验。 然而，对于智能体来说，记忆的价值并不是因为它忠实地描述了 过去，但因为它保留了历史之间的区别 必须在固定预算下保持独立，以支持良好的决策。 我们将其投射为 以决策为中心的率失真问题，通过损失来衡量记忆质量 由压缩引起的可实现的决策质量。 这会产生精确的遗忘 可以安全遗忘的边界，以及表征内存预算和决策质量之间最佳权衡的记忆扭曲边界。 在这种以决策为中心的记忆观的推动下，我们提出Long-horizon language agents must operate under limited runtime memory, yet existing memory mechanisms often organize experience around descriptive criteria—relevance, salience, or summary quality. For an agent, however, memory is valuable not because it faithfully describes the past, but because it preserves the distinctions between histories that must remain separated under a fixed budget to support good decisions. We cast this as a decision-centric rate-distortion problem, measuring memory quality by the loss in achievable decision quality induced by compression. This yields an exact forgetting boundary for what can be safely forgotten, and a memory-distortion frontier characterizing the optimal tradeoff between memory budget and decision quality. Motivated by this decision-centric view of memory, we propose德梅姆DeMem，一个在线记忆学习器，可以提炼 仅当数据证明共享状态会引发决策时才进行分区 冲突，并证明接近极小极大的遗憾保证。 关于受控合成诊断和长期对话 基准测试中，DeMem 在相同的运行时间预算下产生一致的收益， 支持这样的原则：记忆应该保留以下区别： 重要的是决策，而不是描述。, an online memory learner that refines its partition only when data certify that a shared state would induce decision conflict, and prove near-minimax regret guarantees. On both controlled synthetic diagnostics and long-horizon conversational benchmarks, DeMem yields consistent gains under the same runtime budget, supporting the principle that memory should preserve the distinctions that matter for decisions, not descriptions.

1 简介Introduction

大型语言模型 (LLM) 代理越来越多地通过长时间交互进行操作 视野。他们必须使用早期的对话来回答，根据过去的观察进行计划， 并利用在试验和会议中积累的反馈来调整行为Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over long interaction horizons. They must answer using earlier dialogue, plan from past observations, and adapt behavior using feedback accumulated across trials and sessions[43, 34]。 然而，长视野交互仍然受到记忆的瓶颈。增加 仅上下文窗口并不能保证远程证据的可靠使用. Yet long-horizon interaction remains bottlenecked by memory. Increasing the context window alone does not guarantee reliable use of distant evidence[21]，并且最近的基准继续 暴露长期会话记忆、增量交互中的失败， 测试时学习和约束一致回忆, and recent benchmarks continue to expose failures in long-term conversational memory, incremental interaction, test-time learning, and constraint-consistent recall[22, 41, 11, 20].

这些限制促使越来越多的外部和持久的群体 语言模型和代理的记忆机制。检索增强方法 在生成时提供过去的证据These limitations have motivated a growing class of external and persistent memory mechanisms for language models and agents. Retrieval-augmented methods make past evidence available at generation time[18]，同时 操作系统风格和显式长期记忆系统维持超出范围的状态 当前上下文窗口, while OS-style and explicit long-term memory systems maintain state beyond the current context window[27, 40]。 最近的系统通过图结构、自组织、 或面向生产的存储层. More recent systems organize memory through graph-structured, self-organizing, or production-oriented memory layers[9, 3, 24, 16].

现有的代理内存系统通常决定存储、检索或存储什么内容 压缩使用Existing agent memory systems typically decide what to store, retrieve, or compress using描述性的descriptive经验的属性。基于检索 方法优先考虑与当前查询的语义相关性properties of experience. Retrieval-based methods prioritize semantic relevance to the current query[18]，同时 长期和操作系统风格的记忆系统通常依赖于显着性、新近度或 摘要保真度以维持可用的持久状态, while long-term and OS-style memory systems often rely on salience, recency, or summary fidelity to maintain usable persistent state[27, 40]。 图结构和自组织记忆系统进一步组织经验 通过实体链接、时间结构或其他关系线索. Graph-structured and self-organizing memory systems further organize experience through entity links, temporal structure, or other relational cues[9, 3, 24]。 这些标准对于组织过去的经验很有用，但它们并不能直接捕获内存的下游目的：在严格的运行时预算下支持决策。 这种担忧并非假设。在 LoCoMo 基准上，我们发现描述性相似性是. Such criteria are useful for organizing past experience, but they do not directly capture the downstream purpose of memory: supporting decisions under a strict runtime budget. Under a matched answer-time budget, description-based retrieval recovers only66%66\%黄金证据， 相比于of gold evidence, compared to83%83\%对于 DeMem（我们的）。 在基于描述的内存失败的查询中，for DeMem(ours). Among the queries where description-based memory fails,85%85\%的 错误直接追溯到由此造成的证据遗漏或稀释 不匹配（附录of errors trace directly to evidence miss or dilution caused by this mismatch (AppendixE.13, 表格, Tables12–14）。 因此，必须记住的内容应该根据其对 决策的质量，而不是其描述的保真度。). Thus, what must be remembered should be defined by its effect on decision quality, not by its descriptive fidelity.

在本文中，我们通过以下视角研究预算代理记忆：In this paper, we study budgeted agent memory through the lens of以决策为中心的压缩decision-centric compression。这个观点与最近的呼吁一致 用于法学硕士系统中以决策为中心的设计. This view is consistent with recent calls for decision-centric design in LLM systems[37], 但专门针对内存瓶颈的观点：在决策时， 代理不能依赖完整的交互历史记录，而必须访问 过去通过其中之一, but specializes that perspective to the memory bottleneck: at decision time, the agent cannot rely on the full interaction history, and must instead access the past through one ofKK内部存储器状态——可供决策策略使用的固定数量的存储器插槽。因此，预算放在运行时决策状态上，而不是放在离线存储或预处理上。 受此观点的启发，我们建议internal memory states—a fixed number of memory slots available to the decision policy. The budget is therefore placed on runtime decision states, rather than on offline storage or preprocessing. Motivated by this view, we propose德梅姆DeMem，一种预算记忆方法, a budgeted memory method withKK运行时槽。 DeMem 将每个历史查询对路由到一个槽并进行细化 仅当共享内存会产生决策冲突时才使用插槽。这样， 它记住对行动而不是描述重要的区别。runtime slots. DeMem routes each history–query pair to a slot and refines the slots only when shared memory would create a decision conflict. In this way, it remembers distinctions that matter for action rather than description.

我们的贡献回答了这种观点提出的三个具体问题：Our contributions answer three concrete questions raised by this view:

  • •

    历史什么时候可以安全地合并？ ——以决策为中心的遗忘理论。When can histories be safely merged? — A decision-centric theory of forgetting.我们正式确定历史何时可以共享内存而不损害下游决策，从而产生精确的遗忘边界分离 与决策冲突的安全合并以及记忆扭曲边界 描述固定内存预算下可实现的最佳决策质量。We formalize when histories can share memory without hurting downstream decisions, yielding an exact forgetting boundary separating safe merges from decision-conflicting ones, and a memory–distortion frontier describing the best achievable decision quality under a fixed memory budget.

  • •

    如何在线学习决策记忆？ — 经过认证的在线记忆学习器，用于决策意识改进。How can decision-aware memory be learned online? — A certified online memory learner for decision-aware refinement.我们介绍 DeMem，一个在线记忆学习器，它维护We introduce DeMem, an online memory learner that maintainsKK运行时内存状态，仅根据经过认证的决策冲突来细化它们，并提供近极小极大后悔保证。runtime memory states, refines them only upon certified decision conflict, and comes with near-minimax regret guarantees.

  • •

    这个原理能提高代理的实际记忆吗？ — 实用的Does this principle improve practical agent memory? — A practicalKK-插槽代理内存系统。-slot agent memory system.我们通过槽路由和经过认证的细化来实例化 DeMem（图 1 中的说明性 DeMem 工作流程）We instantiate DeMem with slot routing and certified refinement (the illustrative DeMem workflow in Figure1），并在综合诊断和长期对话记忆基准测试上显示出一致的收益。), and show consistent gains on synthetic diagnostics and long-horizon conversational memory benchmarks.

更广泛地说，我们的结果提出了代理内存设计的一个简单原则：More broadly, our results suggest a simple principle for agent memory design:记住决定，而不是描述remember the decision, not the description.

2 相关工作Related Work

状态抽象和决策保留压缩。State abstraction and decision-preserving compression.

我们的工作理论上最接近状态抽象和决策保留 顺序决策中的压缩，包括模型最小化， 近似聚合和策略抽象Our work is theoretically closest to state abstraction and decision-preserving compression in sequential decision making, including model minimization, approximate aggregation, and policy abstraction[19, 8, 31, 1, 2, 48]。这些作品研究何时可以将多个状态视为等效控制，并通过价值、模型或策略保留来表征抽象质量。密切相关的产品线开发了行为指标，包括用于测量状态何时可以近似互换以进行决策的互模拟式距离. These works study when multiple states can be treated as equivalent for control, and characterize abstraction quality through value, model, or policy preservation. A closely related line develops behavioral metrics, including bisimulation-style distances for measuring when states are approximately interchangeable for decision making[6]，而最近的工作将同态思想扩展到连续设置, while more recent work extends homomorphism ideas to continuous settings[32]。我们的设置主要不同在于压缩的对象。 之前的工作抽象了环境状态或动态以进行规划，而我们将交互历史压缩到一组有限的运行时内存状态中，并测量由此产生的决策质量损失。. Our setting differs mainly in the object of compression. Prior work abstracts environment states or dynamics for planning, whereas we compress interaction histories into a limited set of runtime memory states and measure the resulting loss in decision quality.

任务驱动的压缩和有界交互。Task-driven compression and bounded interaction.

我们的表述在精神上也与任务驱动的信息瓶颈估计和控制方法相关，该方法主张仅保留下游决策所需的信息，而不是忠实重建所需的信息Our formulation is also related in spirit to task-driven information bottleneck approaches to estimation and control, which advocate preserving only the information needed for downstream decisions rather than for faithful reconstruction[26]，以及最近围绕下游效用而不是中间描述性目标设计法学硕士系统的以决策为中心的观点, as well as recent decision-centric perspectives on designing LLM systems around downstream utility rather than intermediate descriptive objectives[37]。第二条附近的线研究有界内部状态下的控制，包括用于部分可观察设置的有限状态控制器. A second nearby line studies control under bounded internal state, including finite-state controllers for partially observable settings[36]最近，由有界交互中的主体有界不可区分性引发的规范抽象and, more recently, canonical abstractions induced by agent-bounded indistinguishability in bounded interaction[25]。我们共同的前提是能力限制决定了哪些区别很重要，但为记忆设置提供了具体的形式工具：精确的遗忘边界、记忆扭曲边界和用于在线细化的有限样本后悔保证。. We share the premise that capability constraints determine which distinctions matter, but provide concrete formal tools for the memory setting: an exact forgetting boundary, a memory–distortion frontier, and finite-sample regret guarantees for online refinement.

LLM 代理的记忆系统和学习管理。Memory systems and learned management for LLM agents.

大量工作通过外部或持久记忆（包括基于检索的记忆）增强语言代理A large body of work augments language agents with external or persistent memory, including retrieval-based memory[18], 长期记忆模块, long-term memory modules[40]、操作系统风格或利用管理的内存, operating-system-style or harness-managed memory[27, 14, 29]，图形结构或代理组织的记忆, graph-structured or agentically organized memory[9, 42]、面向生产的存储系统, production-oriented memory systems[3]以及更广泛的工具或外部化层，用于管理上下文、工具使用、持久状态和长期执行, and broader harness or externalization layers that manage context, tool use, persistent state, and long-horizon execution[28, 17, 51]。 另一条线研究学习或代理记忆控制，包括动态笔记组织、记忆动作、基于强化学习的长/短期记忆管理、原子记忆操作、自我进化记忆技能或架构. Another line studies learned or agentic memory control, including dynamic note organization, memory actions, RL-based long-/short-term memory management, atomic memory operations, self-evolving memory skills or architectures[42, 49, 44, 13, 47, 45]，以及长视野或自我进化智能体的记忆推理耦合、情景记忆、时间记忆选择和生成潜在记忆, as well as memory–reasoning coupling, episodic memory, temporal memory selection, and generative latent memory for long-horizon or self-evolving agents[53, 35, 5, 46]。 最近的调查使用基于表示、功能和记忆动态的分类法，超越了长期/短期二分法来组织代理记忆. Recent surveys organize agent memory beyond the long-/short-term dichotomy, using taxonomies based on representation, function, and memory dynamics[50, 12, 4]，而基准测试表明，强大的长期、增量和动作耦合记忆仍然很困难, while benchmarks show that robust long-term, incremental, and action-coupled memory remains difficult[22, 41, 11, 20, 38, 10, 33]。 这些工作推进了记忆机制、训练程序和评估；我们的重点是互补的，描述了有限记忆状态引起的决策损失以及何时可以安全地合并历史。. These works advance memory mechanisms, training procedures, and evaluations; our focus is complementary, characterizing the decision loss induced by bounded memory states and when histories can be safely merged.

3 问题设置和基本限制Problem Setup and Fundamental Limits

本节从基本的记忆公式中发展出以决策为中心的记忆公式。 运行时瓶颈达到其基本极限。我们首先将This section develops the decision-centric memory formulation from the basic runtime bottleneck to its fundamental limits. We first formalize theKK-状态内存约束，代理可以 仅通过有界内部状态访问历史记录。考虑到这个瓶颈，我们然后定义由以下引起的决策失真 压缩，衡量历史记录被压缩时决策质量的损失程度 合并了。这种损失概念使我们能够描述何时合并是安全的：-state memory constraint, where the agent can access history only through a bounded internal state. Given this bottleneck, we then define the decision distortion induced by compression, which measures how much decision quality is lost when histories are merged. 5.2 综合结果Synthetic Results

图Figure2总结了综合结果。 DeMem 在所有预算方法中实现了最低的累积遗憾 (a)，获得了更有利的记忆-扭曲权衡 (b)，并且随着描述性和决策相似性之间的不匹配的增加而扩大了其优势 (c)。 描述感知基线合并需要不同操作的上下文，导致持续的决策错误； DeMem 通过只针对经过认证的决策冲突来优化记忆来避免这种情况。 我们还测量了引起的分区失真（附录summarizes the synthetic results. DeMem achieves the lowest cumulative regret among all budgeted methods (a), attains a more favorable memory–distortion tradeoff (b), and widens its advantage as the mismatch between descriptive and decision similarity grows (c). Description-aware baselines merge contexts that require different actions, leading to persistent decision error; DeMem avoids this by refining memory only on certified decision conflict. We additionally measure the induced partition distortion (AppendixE.1.1, 图, Figure4）：DeMem 始终如一地学习失真度最低的划分，并且下游后悔在不同方法和种子的数量上大致是单调的，证实了该理论预测的机制。 完整的环境定义和基线规范位于附录中): DeMem consistently learns the lowest-distortion partition, and downstream regret is broadly monotone in this quantity across methods and seeds, confirming the mechanism predicted by the theory. Full environment definitions and baseline specifications are in AppendixE.1.

6 结论Conclusion

我们引入了一个以决策为中心的框架，用于预算代理内存，查看 运行时内存作为压缩瓶颈，其质量由 下游决策损失。这个公式产生了一个精确的遗忘边界， 记忆扭曲边界和复杂性度量 必须保留与决策相关的区别。 在此基础上，DeMem 仅在经过认证的情况下改进内存 决定冲突并享受遗憾保证分离不可避免 统计学习的压缩损失。根据经验，DeMem 改进了 固定内存预算下的性能，支持以决策为中心的内存 组织。 总的来说，代理记忆应该保留对行动重要的区别， 不仅仅是描述。同时，DeMem 最好被视为一个预算决策层， 补充更丰富的描述性记忆存储；实施考虑 附录中讨论了更广泛的影响We introduced a decision-centric framework for budgeted agent memory, viewing runtime memory as a compression bottleneck whose quality is measured by downstream decision loss. This formulation yields an exact forgetting boundary, a memory–distortion frontier, and complexity measures for the decision-relevant distinctions that must be retained. Building on this formulation, DeMem refines memory only under certified decision conflict and enjoys regret guarantees that separate unavoidable compression loss from statistical learning. Empirically, DeMem improves performance under fixed memory budgets, supporting decision-centric memory organization. Overall, agent memory should preserve the distinctions that matter for action, not merely description. At the same time, DeMem is best viewed as a budgeted decision layer that complements richer descriptive memory stores; implementation considerations and broader impacts are discussed in AppendicesF和andG.

This isolates the answer-time memory bottleneck analyzed in the main text.

A.3 确定性决策规则Deterministic decision rules

正文中的记忆扭曲边界定义为 确定性编码器和确定性决策规则。这个限制是 故意的。语言代理实现使用确定性解码： 给定一个查询和一个选定的内存槽，答案字符串是固定的。 在线学习者用于探索的随机性是 学习协议，不包含在静态内存压缩中 边境。The memory-distortion frontier in the main text is defined over deterministic encoders and deterministic decision rules. This restriction is intentional. The language-agent implementation uses deterministic decoding: given a query and a selected memory slot, the answer string is fixed. Randomness used by the online learner for exploration is part of the learning protocol and is not included in the static memory-compression frontier.

备注1Remark 1.

确定性边界与我们的代理中使用的应答时间接口相匹配 实施。具有确定性解码、固定查询和选定内存 槽诱导一个固定的生成答案。用于在线探索的随机性是 学习协议的一部分，而静态记忆扭曲边界 描述了部署的确定性应答时间选择器的特征。The deterministic frontier matches the answer-time interface used in our agent implementation. With deterministic decoding, a fixed query and selected memory slot induce a fixed generated answer. Randomness used for online exploration is part of the learning protocol, whereas the static memory–distortion frontier characterizes the deployed deterministic answer-time selector.

科的遗憾保证The regret guarantees of Section4.2假设固定奖励 功能assume a fixed reward functionμ\mu。 在许多代理设置中，决策相关结构可能会发生变化 时间——例如，当用户偏好发生变化或任务分配时 跨会话的变化。 本附录陈述并证明了对标准块静止的扩展 模型，以及匹配的下限。. 附录DAppendix D代理内存实例化和理论与实现的协调Agent Memory Instantiation and Theory–Implementation Alignment

D.1 为什么需要实例化Why an instantiation is needed

该理论将内存建模为有限的运行时状态The theory models memory as a finite runtime stateMt∈[K]M_{t}\in[K]由编码器引起induced by an encoderg:𝒳→[K]g:\mathcal{X}\to[K]。 为了在代理内存系统中实现这种抽象，我们实例化了一个最小的. To realize this abstraction in an agent-memory system, we instantiate a minimalKK-槽机制，其中历史记录在应答时被路由到一组有界的可重用槽标识中。 这种基于槽的视图是正文中研究的预算内存模型的操作形式。 其余的实现选择（包括槽实现、更新规则和路由分数）指定如何在代理管道中表示和维护这些预算决策状态。-slot mechanism in which histories are routed into a bounded set of reusable slot identities at answer time. This slot-based view is the operational form of the budgeted memory model studied in the main text. The remaining implementation choices—including slot realizations, update rules, and routing scores—specify how these budgeted decision states are represented and maintained within an agent pipeline.

D.2 系统组成System components

在每一步，代理都会收到一个上下文At each step, an agent receives a contextxtx_{t}并且必须在严格的运行时间预算下做出下游决策and must make a downstream decision under a strict runtime budget ofKK离散状态。 该实现包含三个模块：discrete states. The implementation contains three modules:

  1. 1.

    内存插槽Memory slots {𝒮k}k=1K\{\mathcal{S}_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K}存储压缩状态信息。storing compressed state information.

  2. 2.

    路由器Router eθ​(xt)∈[K]e_{\theta}(x_{t})\in[K]选择插槽标识。selecting a slot identity.

  3. 3.

    政策Policy πϕ\pi_{\phi}，其下游行为取决于所选槽及其维护的状态实现。, whose downstream behavior is conditioned on the selected slot and its maintained state realization.

内存控制与下游决策。Memory control versus downstream decision.

将内存控制与任务决策分开非常重要。 路由、槽读取、槽更新和认证分割是实现编码器和状态维护机制的内存操作。 相比之下，抽象模型中的操作对应于所选槽支持的下游决策。 在语言代理中，该下游决策可以实现为答案、工具选择或以所选内存状态为条件的另一个任务级控制输出。It is important to separate memory control from task decision. Routing, slot reading, slot updating, and certified splitting are memory operations that implement the encoder and state-maintenance mechanism. By contrast, the action in the abstract model corresponds to the downstream decision supported by the selected slot. In a language agent, this downstream decision may be realized as an answer, a tool choice, or another task-level control output conditioned on the selected memory state.

D.5 经认证的分割作为内存操作Certified split as a memory operation

该理论的操作类比是无法链接约束。 每当路由到同一槽的两个上下文被证明更喜欢冲突的操作时，该槽就会被标记为不一致并有资格进行拆分。The operational analogue of the theory is a cannot-link constraint. Whenever two contexts routed to the same slot are certified to prefer conflicting actions, the slot is marked inconsistent and becomes eligible for splitting.

该对应关系处于运行时决策状态的级别。 查询在应答时直接提供给策略，而对话历史记录可通过以下方式之一访问：The correspondence is at the level of runtime decision states. The query is provided directly to the policy at answer time, while the dialogue history is accessed through one ofKK选定的槽位标识。 因此，内存预算限制了可用于表示历史的运行时状态的数量，而不是所有查询中可能的自然语言答案的数量。 在语言代理实现中，每个槽还维护一个有界实现（例如，文本摘要、紧凑原型或两者兼而有之），通过该实现来具体化选定的内存状态以生成答案。 这些实现不会改变底层的预算状态抽象；它们指定如何在代理管道内表示每个离散内存状态。selected slot identities. Thus the memory budget limits the number of runtime states available for representing history, not the number of possible natural-language answers across all queries. In the language-agent implementation, each slot additionally maintains a bounded realization—for example, a textual summary, a compact prototype, or both—through which the selected memory state is materialized for answer generation. These realizations do not change the underlying budgeted state abstraction; they specify how each discrete memory state is represented inside the agent pipeline.

This three-column view makes it possible to trace any theoretical statement, such as the forgetting boundary of Theorem1或定理的遗憾分解or the regret decomposition of Theorem4，到其在实验系统中的操作对应物。 该跟踪的具体实例如图所示, to its operational counterpart in the experimental system. D.10 LoCoMo 上忠实于理论的核心变体Theory-faithful Core Variant on LoCoMo

为了进一步隔离插槽级内存组织的贡献，我们评估了简化的 DeMem 变体To further isolate the contribution of the slot-level memory organization, we evaluate a reduced DeMem variant on洛科莫LoCoMo，表示为, denotedDeMem-核心DeMem-Core。该变体保留了与完整方法相同的预算槽结构、路由机制和冲突驱动的细化规则，同时删除了完整实现中使用的更丰富的生成时间增强。从这个意义上说，. This variant keeps the same budgeted slot structure, routing mechanism, and conflict-driven refinement rule as the full method, while removing the richer generation-time enhancements used in the complete implementation. In this sense,DeMem-核心DeMem-Core在添加全套实现和生成组件之前，衡量槽组织本身在相同的整体内存机制下可以走多远。measures how far the slot organization itself can go under the same overall memory regime, before adding the full set of realization and generation components.

设置。Setup.

我们使用与主要实验相同的 LoCoMo 预处理、提示模板、应答主干、确定性解码协议和判断设置。回答时间内存预算与主要设置相匹配。相对于整个系统，We use the same LoCoMo preprocessing, prompting template, answering backbone, deterministic decoding protocol, and judge setup as in the main experiments. The answer-time memory budget is matched to the main setting. Relative to the full system,DeMem-核心DeMem-Core使用相同的槽预算和相同的槽分配/经过认证的细化过程，但依赖于应答时减少的槽实现，而不是完整模型使用的更丰富的内存实现。这会产生该方法的更精简版本，同时保留相同的预算内存组织。uses the same slot budget and the same slot assignment / certified refinement procedure, but relies on a reduced slot realization at answer time rather than the richer memory realization used by the complete model. This yields a more stripped-down version of the method while preserving the same budgeted memory organization.

结果。Result.

根据该协议，Under this protocol,DeMem-核心DeMem-CoreLoCoMo 总体得分达到reaches an overall LoCoMo score of90.8。为了紧凑性，我们在这里报告总体得分；类别模式遵循与主要结果相同的定性趋势。. For compactness, we report the overall score here; the category-wise pattern follows the same qualitative trend as in the main results.

讨论。Discussion.

结果表明，最终收益的很大一部分已经来自预算时段组织和冲突驱动的细化机制本身。通过使用更丰富的槽实现和对所选内存状态更强的生成时间使用，完整的实现进一步改进，但简化的变体本身已经具有竞争力。这支持了这样一种观点：DeMem 的核心优势在于如何在固定预算下组织内存，而不仅仅是整个系统的额外实现细节。The result shows that a substantial portion of the final gain already arises from the budgeted slot organization and the conflict-driven refinement mechanism themselves. The full implementation improves further by using richer slot realizations and a stronger generation-time use of the selected memory state, but the reduced variant is already competitive on its own. This supports the view that the central benefit of DeMem lies in how memory is organized under a fixed budget, rather than only in the additional realization details of the full system.

这一规则在设计上是片面的。发射边缘表示候选级别 决策冲突的证据，而没有边缘则不被用作 积极的兼容性声明。这个保守的惯例保留了 确定性基准下理论不可链接逻辑的方向 评价。This rule is one-sided by design. A fired edge indicates candidate-level evidence of decision conflict, while the absence of an edge is not used as a positive compatibility claim. This conservative convention preserves the direction of the theoretical cannot-link logic under deterministic benchmark evaluation.

E.2.1 LoCoMo 的法官提示Judge prompt for LoCoMo

For LoCoMo, we used a binary LLM-as-a-judge protocol. The judge was shown only the reference answer and the response produced by a method.方法名称对法官是隐藏的。 The judge was asked to determine whether the method response correctly matched the reference answer in meaning.For LoCoMo, we used a binary LLM-as-a-judge protocol. 二元判断提示。Binary judge prompt.

系统消息。System message.

You are an impartial evaluator for long-term conversational memory. Your task is to judge whether a method’s response correctly answers the question by comparing it with the reference answer. Evaluate semantic correctness rather than wording style.

用户留言。User message.

You will be given a reference answer and a method response.

Judge whether the method response is correct with respect to the reference answer.

将响应标记为Mark the response as1如果它与参考答案的含义相符。 Paraphrases, minor wording differences, and harmless omissions should still be marked correct if the essential requested information is present.if it matches the reference answer in meaning. 对于时间问题，请特别注意日期、顺序以及响应是否引用与参考答案相同的事件实例。For temporal questions, pay particular attention to dates, ordering, and whether the response refers to the same event instance as the reference answer.

分数：<0 或 1>Score: <0 or 1>

参考答案：Reference answer:

{参考答案}{reference_answer}

{方法_响应}{method_response}

E.4 MemoryArena 的结果Results on MemoryArena

为了评估以决策为中心的记忆是否从对话式 QA 转移到代理任务完成，我们在 MemoryArena 上报告了结果To evaluate whether decision-centric memory transfers beyond conversational QA to agentic task completion, we report results on MemoryArena[10]，一个相互依赖的多会话任务的基准，涵盖形式推理、捆绑网络购物、团体旅行计划、渐进式记忆、网络搜索和数学/物理问题解决。每个类别中的任务都表现出跨会话依赖性：一个会话的输出作为后续会话的先决条件或约束，因此代理必须记住, a benchmark of interdependent multi-session tasks spanning formal reasoning, bundled web shopping, group travel planning, progressive memory, web search, and math/physics problem solving. Tasks within each category exhibit cross-session dependencies: the output of one session serves as a prerequisite or constraint for subsequent sessions, so the agent must remember哪些先前的结果对当前的决定很重要which prior results matter for the current decision，不仅仅是, not merely讨论了什么what was discussed.

我们将 DeMem 与与我们主要实验重叠的三个基线进行比较：长上下文 (GPT-4.1-mini)、Mem0We compare DeMem against three baselines that overlap with our main experiments: Long Context (GPT-4.1-mini), Mem0[3]，以及原始基准测试中报告的四个 RAG 系统（BM25、Text-Embedding-3-Small、MemoRAG、GraphRAG）的平均值。所有方法都使用 GPT-4.1-mini 作为任务代理骨干。我们采用的评估协议、指标和任务划分, and the average of four RAG systems (BM25, Text-Embedding-3-Small, MemoRAG, GraphRAG) reported in the original benchmark. All methods use GPT-4.1-mini as the task agent backbone. We adopt the evaluation protocol, metrics, and task splits ofHe et al. [10]无需修改。 SR 表示成功率（二元任务完成），PS 表示进度分数（部分完成），sPS 表示子任务进度分数。without modification. SR denotes Success Rate (binary task completion), PS denotes Progress Score (partial completion), and sPS denotes sub-task Progress Score.

从表中可以得出几点观察结果Several observations can be made from Table5。首先，DeMem 在五个基于 SR 的类别中获得了最高的平均成功率，平均 SR 为 0.24，而 RAG 为 0.20，长上下文为 0.16，Mem0 为 0.14。改进并不集中在单一设置上：DeMem 在捆绑网络购物、团体旅行计划、渐进式网络搜索、数学形式推理和物理形式推理方面取得了最高的 SR。. First, DeMem obtains the highest average success rate across the five SR-based categories, with an Avg SR of 0.24 compared with 0.20 for RAG, 0.16 for Long Context, and 0.14 for Mem0. The improvement is not concentrated in a single setting: DeMem achieves the highest SR in Bundled Web Shopping, Group Travel Planning, Progressive Web Search, Math Formal Reasoning, and Physics Formal Reasoning.

其次，DeMem 在需要跨会话携带信息的任务设置中显示出相对一致的增益。在渐进式 Web 搜索中，DeMem 的 SR 为 0.27，而 Mem0 为 0.24，RAG 为 0.19。在形式推理方面，DeMem 的数学（0.29 vs. 0.26）和物理（0.55 vs. 0.53）的最强基线也有所提高。这些结果表明，围绕决策相关信息组织记忆有助于保留在以后的会话中有用的依赖关系。Second, DeMem shows relatively consistent gains in task settings that require information to be carried across sessions. On Progressive Web Search, DeMem reaches an SR of 0.27, compared with 0.24 for Mem0 and 0.19 for RAG. On Formal Reasoning, DeMem also improves over the strongest baseline in both Math (0.29 vs. 0.26) and Physics (0.55 vs. 0.53). These results suggest that organizing memory around decision-relevant information can help preserve dependencies that become useful in later sessions.

第三，团体旅行计划对于所有方法来说仍然具有挑战性，正如低硬 SR 值所反映的那样。尽管如此，DeMem 是该类别中唯一具有非零 SR 的方法，并且实现了最高的软进度分数 (sPS = 0.52)，而 RAG 为 0.49，Long Context 为 0.44，Mem0 为 0.24。这表明，在后续计划取决于早期参与者引入的偏好和约束的情况下，以决策为中心的记忆可能会提供适度但一致的好处。Third, Group Travel Planning remains challenging for all methods, as reflected by the low hard SR values. Nevertheless, DeMem is the only method with nonzero SR in this category and achieves the highest soft progress score (sPS = 0.52), compared with 0.49 for RAG, 0.44 for Long Context, and 0.24 for Mem0. This indicates that decision-centric memory may provide modest but consistent benefits in settings where later plans depend on preferences and constraints introduced by earlier participants.

总体而言，MemoryArena 结果显示以决策为中心的记忆在交互式、多会话代理任务中仍然有用，从而补充了我们的会话基准测试结果。在固定的内存预算下，DeMem 倾向于保留与下游决策相关的信息，从而提高不同任务类别的平均任务完成度和进度。Overall, the MemoryArena results complement our conversational benchmark findings by showing that decision-centric memory remains useful in interactive, multi-session agentic tasks. Under a fixed memory budget, DeMem tends to retain information that is relevant for downstream decisions, leading to stronger average task completion and progress across diverse task categories.

E.5 内存预算和延迟的定义Definition of Memory Budget and Latency

图Figure3使用两个资源指标：内存预算和查询时间延迟。uses two resource metrics: memory budget and query-time latency.

内存预算。Memory budget.

对于查询For a queryqq, 让, letMqM_{q}表示denote the最终记忆内容实际注入到应答模型中final memory content actually injected into the answering model。 我们将查询级内存预算定义为. We define the query-level memory budget as

B​(q)=chars​(Mq),B(q)=\mathrm{chars}(M_{q}),

哪里wherechars​(⋅)\mathrm{chars}(\cdot)计算最终注入的内存字符串中的字符数。 同样，可以使用标记代替字符；在我们的图中，我们对所有方法都使用一个一致的单位。counts the number of characters in the final injected memory string. Equivalently, one may use tokens instead of characters; throughout our plots we use a single consistent unit for all methods.

这个定义是基于已实现的This definition is based on the realized回答时间answer-time内存占用，而不是离线存储大小或内部状态大小。 对于具有结构化记忆的方法（例如，槽、实体、边或检索到的证据），我们首先将最终的记忆对象序列化为提供给应答模型的确切文本块，然后计算其长度。 因此，预算以与方法无关的方式反映了推理时可用的内存量。memory footprint, rather than offline storage size or internal state size. For methods with structured memory (e.g., slots, entities, edges, or retrieved evidence), we first serialize the final memory objects into the exact text block provided to the answering model, and then count its length. Thus, the budget reflects the amount of memory made available at inference time in a method-agnostic way.

为了对话For a dialoguedd带有评估问题with evaluation questionsQdQ_{d}，我们报告对话级平均预算：, we report the dialogue-level average budget:

B​(d)=1|Qd|​∑q∈QdB​(q).B(d)=\frac{1}{|Q_{d}|}\sum_{q\in Q_{d}}B(q).
查询时延迟。Query-time latency.

对于查询For a queryqq, 让, lettstart​(q)t_{\mathrm{start}}(q)为系统收到查询的时间，令be the time when the system receives the query, and lettend​(q)t_{\mathrm{end}}(q)是返回最终答案的时间。 我们将查询时间延迟定义为be the time when the final answer is returned. We define query-time latency as

L​(q)=tend​(q)−tstart​(q).L(q)=t_{\mathrm{end}}(q)-t_{\mathrm{start}}(q).

该延迟包括所有This latency includes all在线online回答查询所需的操作，包括检索、路由、内存读出、可选的重新排序、提示组装和答案生成。 它排除operations needed to answer the query, including retrieval, routing, memory readout, optional reranking, prompt assembly, and answer generation. It excludes离线offline或摊销预处理成本，例如语料库索引、内存构建、定期重建或后台维护。or amortized preprocessing costs such as corpus indexing, memory construction, periodic rebuilding, or background maintenance.

为了对话For a dialoguedd，我们报告对话级平均延迟：, we report the dialogue-level average latency:

L​(d)=1|Qd|​∑q∈QdL​(q).L(d)=\frac{1}{|Q_{d}|}\sum_{q\in Q_{d}}L(q).

E.8 带注释的 LoCoMo 子集的决策兼容性审核Decision-Compatibility Audit on an Annotated LoCoMo Subset

为了补充正文中精确的合成机制验证，我们还评估了实现的记忆状态是否更To complement the exact synthetic mechanism validation in the main text, we additionally evaluate whether the realized memory states are more决策兼容decision-compatible在现实的基准实例上。 我们构造一个带注释的子集on realistic benchmark instances. We construct an annotated subset of洛科莫LoCoMo其中每个评估实例都与一个黄金支持集相关联，该支持集由正确回答问题所需的最小历史回合/事实组成。 这使我们不仅可以评估最终任务答案的质量，还可以评估匹配答案堆栈下记忆组织本身的质量。in which each evaluation instance is associated with a gold support set consisting of the minimal history turns / facts needed to answer the question correctly. This allows us to assess not only end-task answer quality, but also the quality of the memory organization itself under a matched answer stack.

设置。Setup.

所有方法都在与主要实验相同的回答主干、提示模板、确定性解码协议和回答时间内存预算下进行评估。 这里的比较隔离了内存组织的影响。 对于每个评估实例，我们确定在回答时选择的记忆状态并计算四个支持级别指标：All methods are evaluated under the same answering backbone, prompting template, deterministic decoding protocol, and answer-time memory budget as in the main experiments. The comparison here isolates the effect of memory organization. For each evaluation instance, we identify the memory state selected at answer time and compute four support-level metrics:

  • •

    支持纯度Support Purity (↑\uparrow)：所选内存状态内黄金支持事实的平均纯度。): the average purity of gold support facts within the selected memory state.

  • •

    槽内冲突率Within-slot Conflict Rate (↓\downarrow)：所选内存状态内的共同路由项目的比例，其黄金支持对于下游问题是相互不兼容的。): the fraction of co-routed items inside the selected memory state whose gold supports are mutually incompatible for the downstream question.

  • •

    黄金支持范围Gold-support Coverage (↑\uparrow)：包含在所选内存状态中的黄金支持集的分数。): the fraction of the gold support set that is contained in the selected memory state.

  • •

    支持污染Support Contamination (↓\downarrow)：所选内存内容中不属于黄金支持集的部分。): the fraction of the selected memory content that does not belong to the gold support set.

作为最终任务指标，我们还报告As an end-task metric, we also report法官平均数Judge Mean (↑\uparrow），即主要实验中使用的相同判断方案下的平均答案分数。), i.e., the mean answer score under the same judge protocol used in the main experiments.

比较方法。Compared methods.

我们将完整的 DeMem 系统与同一基准子集上的两个匹配控件进行比较： (一)We compare the full DeMem system against two matched controls on the same benchmark subset: (i)特性路由Feature Routing，通过语义相似性来路由记忆； (二), which routes memory by semantic similarity; and (ii)RAG 不带认证分体式RAG w/o Certified Split，它使用传统的启发式分块/检索，没有经过决策认证的细化。 选择这些控件来代表相同任务设置下的现实非决策感知替代方案，而不是受控老虎机环境中使用的合成基线。, which uses traditional heuristic chunking / retrieval without decision-certified refinement. These controls are chosen to represent realistic non-decision-aware alternatives under the same task setting, rather than the synthetic baselines used in the controlled bandit environment.

结果。Result.

表Table7表明 DeMem 是唯一在所有四个支持级别指标上都表现最好的方法，同时还获得了最高的下游判断分数。 与相比shows that DeMem is the only method that is best on all four support-level metrics while also achieving the highest downstream judge score. Compared with特性路由Feature Routing，DeMem 大幅提高了支撑纯度（0.394 vs. 0.215）和金支撑覆盖率（0.825 vs. 0.641），同时大幅减少了槽内冲突（0.273 vs. 0.582）和支撑污染（0.241 vs. 0.533）。 与相比, DeMem substantially increases support purity (0.394 vs. 0.215) and gold-support coverage (0.825 vs. 0.641), while sharply reducing within-slot conflict (0.273 vs. 0.582) and support contamination (0.241 vs. 0.533). Compared withRAG 不带认证分体式RAG w/o Certified Split，DeMem 再次改进了每个机制指标，冲突和污染显着降低，最终答案质量显着提高。, DeMem again improves every mechanism metric, with notably lower conflict and contamination and markedly better final answer quality.

讨论。Discussion.

该审计的目的与正文中精确的综合失真分析不同。 在合成环境中，由于奖励函数已知，因此可以准确地测量理论对象。 在现实的基准数据上，确切的数量是无法直接观察到的；相反，带注释的支持审计衡量实现的内存状态是否保留对下游答案重要的区别。 结果表明，DeMem 不仅能产生更好的最终答案：它还能将记忆组织成更纯粹的支持状态、更少的内部冲突，并且与任务所需的黄金证据更好地保持一致。 这大大加强了理论与系统的桥梁： 综合分析在受控环境中准确地验证了决策保留机制，而带注释的 LoCoMo 审计表明，相同的原理也体现在现实的长期数据上实现的代理记忆系统中。This audit serves a different purpose from the exact synthetic distortion analysis in the main text. In the synthetic environment, the theory object can be measured exactly because the reward function is known. On realistic benchmark data, that exact quantity is not directly observable; instead, the annotated support audit measures whether the realized memory states preserve the distinctions that matter for downstream answering. The results show that DeMem does not merely produce better final answers: it also organizes memory into states that are more support-pure, less internally conflicting, and better aligned with the gold evidence needed for the task. This substantially strengthens the theory-to-system bridge: the synthetic analysis validates the decision-preserving mechanism exactly in a controlled setting, while the annotated LoCoMo audit shows that the same principle manifests in the realized agent-memory system on realistic long-horizon data.

外卖。Takeaway.

结合正文中的综合机制分析和匹配的消融，带注释的 LoCoMo 审计支持以下解释： DeMem 的优势来自于围绕与动作相关的区别来组织有界记忆，而不仅仅是通用语义分组或启发式检索。Taken together with the synthetic mechanism analysis and the matched ablations in the main text, the annotated LoCoMo audit supports the following interpretation: the advantage of DeMem comes from organizing bounded memory around action-relevant distinctions, rather than only from generic semantic grouping or heuristic retrieval.

E.9 对带注释的 LoCoMo 子集的分区干预Partition Intervention on the Annotated LoCoMo Subset

为了进一步隔离内存组织的影响，我们比较了带注释的四种分区策略To further isolate the effect of memory organization, we compare four partition policies on the annotated洛科莫LoCoMo子集： (一) 一个subset: (i) a随机分区Random Partition下界， (二)lower bound, (ii) a基于特征的分区Feature-based Partition通过语义相似性对记忆进行分组， （三）所学的that groups memory by semantic similarity, (iii) the learned内存分区DeMem Partition, (iv) 一个, and (iv) anOracle支持分区Oracle-support Partition由带注释的金支撑结构构造而成。 该实验被设计为分区级干预：比较的目标是诱导内存分区本身的质量，而不是更广泛的系统堆栈。constructed from the annotated gold support structure. This experiment is designed as a partition-level intervention: the comparison targets the quality of the induced memory partition itself, rather than the broader system stack.

对于每个分区，我们报告两个支持级别数量：For each partition, we report two support-level quantities:覆盖范围Coverage (↑\uparrow)，所选内存状态中包含的黄金支持集的分数， 和), the fraction of the gold support set contained in the selected memory state, and污染Contamination (↓\downarrow)，所选内存内容中不属于黄金支持集的部分。), the fraction of selected memory content that does not belong to the gold support set.

解释。Interpretation.

结果在内存分区质量和任务相关支持结构之间提供了直接的真实基准桥梁。 随机分区无法保留黄金支撑集并引入严重污染。 基于特征的分区比随机分组有所改进，但在支持恢复和支持纯度方面仍然比 DeMem 差很多。 相比之下，学习到的 DeMem 分区在两个指标上都接近 oracle-support 上限，这表明它的优势不仅仅是由于通用语义分组，而是由于分区更忠实地保留了下游应答所需的支持区别。The result provides a direct real-benchmark bridge between memory partition quality and task-relevant support structure. A random partition fails to preserve the gold support set and introduces heavy contamination. A feature-based partition improves over random grouping, but remains substantially worse than DeMem on both support recovery and support purity. By contrast, the learned DeMem partition approaches the oracle-support upper bound on both metrics, indicating that its advantage is not merely due to generic semantic grouping, but to a partition that more faithfully preserves the support distinctions needed for downstream answering.

E.11 经过认证的分离：LoCoMo 上的触发频率和精度Certified Split: Trigger Frequency and Accuracy on LoCoMo

该理论要求只有当数据 证明共同路由的上下文具有相互冲突的证据要求 （第 5.2 节）。我们审核该房产是否已实现 系统通过测量分裂被触发的频率以及它们是否 对应真实的证据冲突。The theory requires that memory states be refined only when the data certify that co-routed contexts have conflicting evidence requirements (Section 5.2). We audit whether this property holds in the realized system by measuring how often splits are triggered and whether they correspond to genuine evidence conflicts.

设置。Setup.

我们在完整的 LoCoMo 评估集上检测 DeMem 管道， 记录内存构建过程中的每个分割事件。对于每个分割，我们 记录触发对话回合、被分割的槽位以及一对 产生冲突信号的上下文。然后我们评估分割质量 使用来自带注释的 LoCoMo 子集的黄金支持注释 （附录We instrument the DeMem pipeline on the full LoCoMo evaluation set and record every split event during memory construction. For each split, we log the triggering dialogue turn, the slot being split, and the pair of contexts that produced the conflict signal. We then assess split quality using the gold support annotations from the annotated LoCoMo subset (AppendixE.8).这些注释仅用于分割精度的事后审核 并回忆；它们不会提供给分割触发器、路由器、应答器或 记忆构建过程中的反馈判断。).These annotations are used only for post-hoc auditing of split precision and recall; they are not provided to the split trigger, router, answerer, or feedback judge during memory construction.

总结。Summary.

Analysis 3 confirms that this gap is因果关系causally linked到 下游错误：to downstream errors:85%85\%基于描述的故障是 可归因于证据缺失或淡化。综合起来，这些结果 确定描述-决策不匹配不是 假设的关注点，但在数量上占主导地位的记忆来源 现实的长期数据效率低下。of description-based failures are attributable to evidence miss or dilution. Together, these results establish that the description–decision mismatch is not a hypothetical concern but a quantitatively dominant source of memory inefficiency on realistic long-horizon data.

至关重要的是，这三种分析形成了一个封闭的诊断链： 代理信息不丰富（分析 1），代理信息不丰富会导致 检索时可测量的信息丢失（分析 2），并且 信息丢失是下游任务失败的主要原因 （分析 3）。该链排除了两个主要替代方案 解释——描述相似性是一个嘈杂但仍然 有用的信号，或者检索间隙存在但被补偿 答案模型——并提供直接的经验基础 用以决策为中心的标准取代描述性标准 预算内存的组织原则。Crucially, the three analyses form a closed diagnostic chain: the proxy is uninformative (Analysis 1), the uninformative proxy causes measurable information loss at retrieval time (Analysis 2), and that information loss is the dominant cause of downstream task failure (Analysis 3). This chain rules out the two main alternative explanations—that description similarity is a noisy but still useful signal, or that retrieval gaps exist but are compensated by the answering model—and provides a direct empirical basis for replacing descriptive criteria with decision-centric ones as the organizing principle of budgeted memory.

E.14 LoCoMo 人类与法学硕士法官协议Human–LLM Judge Agreement on LoCoMo

为了验证法学硕士作为法官的协议，我们随机抽取了 150 个评估样本 来自 LoCoMo 测试集的实例（在四个查询中分层 类别）并收集来自三个独立的二元正确性判断 具有研究生水平 NLP 经验的人类注释者。每个注释者都会收到 对话历史、查询、金证、系统答案， 并按照使用的相同规则分配二进制正确/不正确标签 由法学硕士评委。To validate the LLM-as-judge protocol, we randomly sample 150 evaluation instances from the LoCoMo test set (stratified across the four query categories) and collect binary correctness judgments from three independent human annotators with graduate-level NLP experience. E.14.1 人类注释协议和道德规范Human annotation protocol and ethics

为了验证法学硕士法官评估的可靠性，我们对 150 个 LoCoMo 评估实例进行了一项小规模的人类一致性研究，这些实例在四个查询类别中分层。该研究仅用于评估人类判断与法学硕士法官之间的一致性；它不用于训练 DeMem、调整超参数、选择模型或构建报告的基准测试集。To validate the reliability of our LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, we conducted a small-scale human agreement study on 150 LoCoMo evaluation instances, stratified across the four query categories. The study was used only to assess agreement between human judgments and the LLM judge; it was not used to train DeMem, tune hyperparameters, select models, or construct the reported benchmark test set.

注释者。Annotators.

我们招募了三位具有研究生水平 NLP 经验的独立注释者。注释者是根据事先对自然语言评估任务的熟悉程度来选择的，并且不知道哪个系统产生了每个答案。系统名称在注释过程中被匿名化，以减少方法特定的偏差。We recruited three independent annotators with graduate-level NLP experience. Annotators were selected based on prior familiarity with natural language evaluation tasks and were not informed of which system produced each answer. System names were anonymized during annotation to reduce method-specific bias.

注释任务。Annotation task.

对于每个实例，注释者都会看到对话历史记录、用户查询、黄金证据或参考支持、可用的参考答案以及一个匿名系统答案。注释者按照与 LLM-as-a-judge 协议相同的标准分配了二进制正确性标签。该任务要求注释者通过提供的对话证据来判断事实的正确性和支持，而不是流畅性或文体质量。For each instance, annotators were shown the dialogue history, the user query, the gold evidence or reference support, the reference answer when available, and one anonymized system answer. Annotators assigned a binary correctness label following the same rubric used for the LLM-as-a-judge protocol. The task asked annotators to judge factual correctness and support by the provided dialogue evidence, rather than fluency or stylistic quality.

给注释者的指示。Instructions given to annotators.

注释者收到以下指示：Annotators received the following instructions:

您将看到对话历史记录、问题、黄金证据或参考支持，以及候选系统答案。您的任务是根据提供的对话证据确定候选人的答案是否正确。You will be shown a dialogue history, a question, gold evidence or reference support, and a candidate system answer. Your task is to decide whether the candidate answer is correct with respect to the provided dialogue evidence.

将答案标记为Mark the answer as正确Correct如果它回答了问题并得到所提供的对话证据的支持。如果答案包含所要求的信息，细微的措辞差异、释义或无害的遗漏仍应标记为正确。if it answers the question and is supported by the provided dialogue evidence. Minor wording differences, paraphrases, or harmless omissions should still be marked Correct if the answer contains the requested information.

将答案标记为Mark the answer as不正确Incorrect如果它与对话相矛盾，使用了错误的时间段或实体，错过了所要求的信息，给出了不受支持的答案，或者太模糊而无法回答问题。if it contradicts the dialogue, uses the wrong time period or entity, misses the requested information, gives an unsupported answer, or is too vague to answer the question.

E.17 与反馈感知内存基线的比较Comparison with feedback-aware memory baselines

主要基准表将 DeMem 与一系列基于检索的、 相同回答时间记忆下的静态和固定程序记忆系统 预算。为了在自适应记忆设置中进一步评估 DeMem，我们另外 与内存策略由下游任务决定的两种方法进行比较 信号或记忆动作：MemSkill 和 MemAct。The main benchmark tables compare DeMem against a broad set of retrieval-based, static, and fixed-procedure memory systems under the same answer-time memory budget. To further evaluate DeMem in an adaptive-memory setting, we additionally compare against two methods whose memory policies are shaped by downstream task signals or memory actions: MemSkill and MemAct.

MemSkill 学习使用下游任务选择记忆技能的控制器 从困难案例中发出信号并发展技能库； MemAct 制定记忆 管理作为政策行动，并培训背景管理政策 强化学习。这些方法提供了互补的自适应记忆 超出仅检索系统的基线。MemSkill learns a controller for selecting memory skills using downstream task signals and evolves the skill bank from hard cases; MemAct formulates memory management as policy actions and trains a context-curation policy with reinforcement learning. These methods provide complementary adaptive-memory baselines beyond retrieval-only systems.

DeMem obtains the best overall score and the strongest Temporal, Open-Domain, and Multi-Hop performance, while MemSkill is slightly better on Single-Hop questions. These results indicate that decision-aware certified refinement remains effective when compared with learning-based memory policies, not only with static retrieval pipelines.

附录GAppendix G更广泛的影响声明Broader Impact Statement

这项工作确定了代理记忆的正确分析单位不是保留的信息，而是保留的决策。这种区别不仅仅是技术上的——它重新划定了智能体需要知道的内容和它能够忘记的内容之间的界限，并将该界限建立在可测量、可优化和可证明严格的数量上。This work establishes that the right unit of analysis for agent memory is not information preserved, but decisions preserved. This distinction is not merely technical — it redraws the boundary between what an agent needs to know and what it can afford to forget, grounding that boundary in a quantity that is measurable, optimizable, and provably tight.

在基础层面上，我们的结果为语言代理的有限理性理论提供了一个缺失的部分：当目标是行动而不是重建时，如何分配有限内存的正式说明。据我们所知，我们得出的速率失真边界是预算代理记忆在可实现的决策质量而不是表征保真度方面的基本限制的第一个特征。 NP 完备性结果（定理 3）进一步揭示，在最坏的情况下，最优内存分配在计算上是不可约的——这种结构洞察限制了所有未来内存系统的设计空间，而不仅仅是我们的。At a foundational level, our results contribute a missing piece to the theory of bounded rationality in language agents: a formal account of how finite memory should be allocated when the objective is action, not reconstruction. The rate-distortion frontier we derive is, to our knowledge, the first characterization of the fundamental limits of budgeted agent memory in terms of achievable decision quality rather than representational fidelity. The NP-completeness result (Theorem 3) further reveals that optimal memory allocation is computationally irreducible in the worst case — a structural insight that constrains the design space of all future memory systems, not only ours.

实际上，随着语言代理被部署在高风险、长期的环境中——临床对话、法律案件管理、个性化教育、多会话谈判——问题Practically, as language agents are deployed in high-stakes, long-horizon settings — clinical dialogue, legal case management, personalized education, multi-session negotiation — the question of要记住什么what to remember就与这个问题密不可分becomes inseparable from the question of该怎么办what to do。通过描述性显着性来压缩记忆的系统可能会保留生动但与决策无关的细节，同时丢弃微妙但对行动至关重要的区别。我们的框架提供了一个原则性的替代方案：判断记忆的标准是它是否保留了良好行动的能力，而当它不损害这种能力时，遗忘就是被允许的。该标准与架构无关（附录 E.12），可用作现有内存系统的嵌入式评估镜头或选择模块。. Systems that compress memory by descriptive salience risk retaining vivid but decision-irrelevant detail while discarding subtle but action-critical distinctions. Our framework provides a principled alternative: memory is judged by whether it preserves the capacity to act well, and forgetting is permitted exactly when it does not compromise that capacity. This criterion is architecture-agnostic (Appendix E.12) and can serve as a drop-in evaluation lens or selection module for existing memory systems.

以决策为中心的内存优化了为下游保留的信息 任务表现。在已部署的系统中，该目标应与 特定于应用程序的保留策略、面向用户的透明度以及定期 对存储和遗忘信息的审核。这些保障措施是互补的 符合我们的技术框架并帮助将内存优化与隐私结合起来， 治理和用户控制要求。Decision-centric memory optimizes what information is retained for downstream task performance. In deployed systems, this objective should be paired with application-specific retention policies, user-facing transparency, and periodic audits of stored and forgotten information. These safeguards are complementary to our technical framework and help align memory optimization with privacy, governance, and user-control requirements.

更广泛地说，我们希望这项工作能够鼓励社区评估智能体的记忆，而不是根据它记住了多少，而是根据它是否记住了重要的事情。More broadly, we hope this work encourages the community to evaluate agent memory not by how much it remembers, but by whether it remembers what matters.
